methodology.calibration_refinement: bounded additional pilots up to one native second, at most calibration-iterations
methodology.cpu: server cumulative CPU around native process; includes startup/client handshake interval
methodology.durability: acknowledged-write benchmark; no crash-recovery or equal guarantee claim
methodology.engine_order: ffkv then redis on even zero-based repetitions; reversed on odd
methodology.isolation: fresh owned child and temporary directory per engine/case/repetition
methodology.latency: Unmodified redis-benchmark CSV latency in milliseconds. Redis 8.2.1 records send-to-first-socket-read-event latency before parsing replies, reusing that sample for every reply in a pipeline. This is neither batch-completion latency nor individual-reply latency, and is never divided by pipeline depth. The native histogram clamps samples at 3000000 microseconds (3 seconds). Only fields actually emitted by this binary are reported; these source-level semantics were established for Redis 8.2.1, not arbitrary client versions.
methodology.maintenance: ffkv automatic WAL checkpoints and Redis auto AOF rewrites disabled
methodology.native_throughput_caveat: Redis 8.2.1 threaded completion detection uses a 250ms timer; short-pilot rps is quantized
methodology.random_keys: native-bench: plus 12 zero-padded digits; uniform native -r domain
methodology.seed_limit: fixed seed does not promise identical interleaving across native client threads
methodology.writes: SET/HSET vary a fixed-width numeric payload suffix; ZADD varies the existing member score, rather than timing only same-value no-ops
